# Title

## Status

Accepted | Proposed | Deprecated

## Context

Briefly describe the user need, platform behavior, or technical constraint that forced this decision.

## Decision

State the implementation choice in one or two short paragraphs.

## Technical Limitations

- List hard constraints that the implementation cannot remove.
- Name the boundary owner when relevant, such as Chrome, DeepL, or the page DOM.

## Alternatives Considered

- **Alternative:** Why it was rejected or deferred.

## Consequences

- Positive effect.
- Cost, trade-off, or follow-up burden.

## Validation

- Tests, manual checks, or docs that validate the decision.

## Revisit When

- Specific condition that would justify changing this decision.
